name: residential_rs2_month_per_tract
description: RS2: DoPopulationChange reads the month per tract (when the new total is non-zero) and latches nothing, so a month that changes in the middle of a pass is seen by the tracts after the change. A flat LE of 100 avoids the reset. Two steady (10, 0, 0) tracts at age 40: tract (0, 0) in month 11 stays 40; tract (1, 0) in month 12 becomes 41. Each populated tract reads the month once.
